risk_register: Customs & Ports: high variance on A100 shipments from SEA -> EU (est delay +30-60 days). Mitigation: shift 40% of allocation to H100 staggered shipments or use cloud partner for short-term burst.

VendorA capacity clamp: VendorA confirmed capacity hit in Q1 2026 due to wafer shortages. Impact: 160-unit ORD-2025-091 may slip by 3-6 weeks. Contingency: convert 40 units to alternate vendor quote (VendorB) if not confirmed by 2026-01-25.
Refurb supply quality: SecondaryBroker refurbished H100 units require additional burn-in. Risk score: medium-high. Action: allocate 2-week staging + 72-hour stress test prior to integration.
Logistics funding timing: CAPEX release delay could push DistributorX shipment hold. Finance action required by 2026-02-15 to avoid hold. Score: high immediate.

Regional demand shift: sudden enterprise customer in APAC requesting 100 GPUs reserved for Dedicated in May 2026. Current APAC headroom insufficient. Plan: prioritize SPOT-POOL-1 and move 40 units from us-east1 backfill.
